name: emdysi
description: English grammar, spelling, style and AI-writing checks with a full grammar of English, as you write

emdysi.path.description: The `en` executable: a name on the PATH, or a full path (`C:\\Tools\\en\\en.exe` on Windows). In a workspace you have not trusted, only your user setting counts.

emdysi.args.description: Options for `en lsp`, e.g. ["--pack", "google", "--glossary", "docs/terms.toml", "--disable", "plain-style.passive"]. Relative paths are read from the workspace folder. In a workspace you have not trusted, only your user setting counts.

emdysi.minSeverity.description: Show only findings this severe or worse.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, emdysi ignores the workspace's emdysi.path and emdysi.args (a cloned repository could otherwise name a program of its own to run) and uses your user settings.
